provenance: Roster and identity from the operator flyer (SenStadt Berlin, sapos-flyer_2026.pdf): the Berlin SAPOS system runs three own reference stations - RS-ID 0897 Berlin-Wittenau, 0898 Berlin-Gruenau, 0899 Berlin-Dahlem - networked with Potsdam (RS-ID 0028, a Brandenburg station pinned under sapos_bb) and four further Brandenburg stations. Station names equal their direct mounts on www.sapos-be-ntrip.de:2102 (RTCM 3.2 MSM, Basic-auth; the sourcetable reports placeholder coords 52.00/13.00, so it cannot be the coordinate source). Berlin publishes no machine-readable station coordinates (geoportal CSW empty, flyer map is an image), so coordinates are the named locality's centre to 2 decimals (~1 km).
